feed.title: US Measles Tracker
feed.subtitle: Independent, sourced tracker of the 2026 US measles surge: CDC case counts, cases by state, outbreaks, deaths, elimination status and a dated timeline.

entry.title: Pennsylvania: 1,398 cases in 44 counties
entry.summary: The state health department's update counts 1,398 confirmed cases in 44 counties, 38 more than on 26 October, with 265 hospitalisations and 5 confirmed measles-associated deaths. The department gave no new information on a further death reported by the Franklin County coroner, and CDC counts three deaths nationally.
entry.content:
The state health department's update counts 1,398 confirmed cases in 44 counties, 38 more than on 26 October, with 265 hospitalisations and 5 confirmed measles-associated deaths. The department gave no new information on a further death reported by the Franklin County coroner, and CDC counts three deaths nationally.

Sources: Reuters via Investing.com, abc27, River Reporter

entry.title: CDC confirms a third measles death
entry.summary: CDC added a third measles death to its national count, up from two. Reuters and Al Jazeera report that CDC confirmed it after the National Center for Health Statistics verified that measles was listed as the underlying cause of death on a death certificate. CDC has not said where the death occurred and says its count could change as reviews continue. Pennsylvania's own count is five.
entry.content:
CDC added a third measles death to its national count, up from two. Reuters and Al Jazeera report that CDC confirmed it after the National Center for Health Statistics verified that measles was listed as the underlying cause of death on a death certificate. CDC has not said where the death occurred and says its count could change as reviews continue. Pennsylvania's own count is five.

Sources: Reuters via Yahoo News, Al Jazeera, The Hill

entry.title: Pennsylvania: 1,078 cases in 41 counties
entry.summary: The state health department's Wednesday update counts 1,078 confirmed cases, 207 hospitalisations and 5 measles-associated deaths. Lancaster County has 401 cases and Mifflin County 153. About 40 of the 74 cases added since 5 October were older infections only recently confirmed, and the department said the update does not reflect a current surge in new infections.

entry.title: Pennsylvania passes 1,000 cases; New York declares a disaster emergency
entry.summary: Pennsylvania reaches 1,004 cases in 39 counties, the first US state past 1,000 in a year since 1991. New York's governor declares a state disaster emergency through 4 November and lets pharmacists, paramedics and midwives vaccinate.
entry.content:
Pennsylvania reaches 1,004 cases in 39 counties, the first US state past 1,000 in a year since 1991. New York's governor declares a state disaster emergency through 4 November and lets pharmacists, paramedics and midwives vaccinate.

Sources: Pennsylvania Dept. of Health, Philadelphia Inquirer, New York Governor's office, NBC News

entry.title: One year since the West Texas outbreak began
entry.summary: The outbreak that began in West Texas on 20 January 2025 marks a year with US cases reported every week. Elimination is lost if one chain of spread lasts 12 months or more.
